stimuli.description: 13 different sound tracks of actual classroom noise (group work, conversation between adult and child speakers in English), 8-25 sec long, presented at 55-60 dB(A).

tables.description: Mean performance (M) and standard deviation (SD) in three age groups and in all tasks.

limitations: Classroom noise might lack deviants in the quantity and quality necessary to trigger a deviation effect.
Children's daily exposure to classroom noise and thus habituation could occlude age-related differences.
Sample size in each age group (N < 100) limits the interpretation of correlation findings.
Floor performance in paired-associate recall may result in an underestimation of a disturbance impact of irrelevant sound.
